Are you looking to buy a scoby? It can be tricky to buy them online because sometimes they will give you a tiny test tube with a chunk of scoby & hardly any starter. You are going to want scoby AND starter. Don't buy just a scoby it makes it alot harder to get started. Are you on fb? There is a group there called Wild Fermentation Uncensored & you could ask in there. People share cultures all the time for the price of postage. The folks in the group are very knowledgeable. If you're not on fb Brooklyn Kombucha is a good company & I will give you step by step instructions & answer any questions you may have once you are ready to get started!

I just read your post again (sorry it's late) & saw you can't buy on line. Can you get a bottle of plain raw kombucha? You can get brewing kombucha that way too. Let me know & I'll give you instructions.

I found some instructions about making a SCOBY from a pre bought bottle of Kombucha, ever try?

Yes! I have done that! I poured it into a jar & put some cloth over it & secured it with a rubber band. Then I let it sit for about a month. That makes the starter nice & tart & stong! I measured my starter. You want 2 cups per gallon of tea. Then I made my batch! Be sure to keep 2 cups of starter every time! It keeps away mold. :)
